scanner.title: Check anything suspicious
scanner.subtitle: Paste it exactly as you received it. The more you include — links, amounts, phone numbers — the more we can check.
scanner.ctaHintAuth: · Sign in to keep a history of your scans
scanner.resultPlaceholderText: Pick a channel above, paste what you received, and we will show the risk score, the exact reasons behind it, and what to do next.
scanner.trySampleSubtitle: Real {{channel}} examples — two scams and one genuine.
scanner.privacyText: Scan text is truncated to 2,000 characters before it is stored, and it is never sent to any outside service — everything runs on this machine. Use the landing-page scanner if you would rather nothing be stored at all.
scanner.emergencyText: Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in immediately. Accounts can often still be frozen in the first few hours — after that it becomes very difficult.
scanner.emptyError: Paste the message you want checked first.
scanner.offlineError: Cannot reach the CREDIFY.ai server. Start the backend on port 8000 and try again.
scanner.analysisFailedText: Something went wrong while analysing that.
scanner.reportSuccessText: Your report helps warn other people about this scam.
scanner.copiedText: The full report is on your clipboard.

landing.heroSubtitle: Paste any suspicious SMS, call script, email, link or UPI request and get an instant, explainable risk verdict. Free, offline, no login required.
landing.statsTitle: The scale of the problem in India
landing.channelsSubtitle: Scams rarely stay in one channel. An SMS leads to a call, the call leads to a link, the link leads to a UPI request.
landing.trySubtitle: No login, no app install. Paste a message and see how a verdict is built.

footer.tagline: An explainable AI-powered scam and fraud warning assistant for SMS, calls, email, links and UPI payment requests. Built to protect everyday digital decisions.
footer.safetyBanner: Already lost money? Report immediately at <0>cybercrime.gov.in</0> or call <1><2>1930</2></1>. The first few hours are critical — accounts can still be frozen.
footer.disclaimer: We never contact anyone on your behalf. Scan text is truncated before storage. No external APIs are called.

login.subtitleSignIn: Signing in is optional — the scanner works without it. It just keeps your history.
login.subtitleRegister: It takes a few seconds and keeps your scan history in one place.
login.demoAccounts: DEMO ACCOUNTS — click to fill in

aside.title: Your scans, kept together.
aside.subtitle: An account is not required to check a message. It exists so you can look back at what you were sent, and so your reports can help other people.

login.filledInText: {{role}} credentials are ready — press Sign in.
login.validationPassword: Password must be at least 6 characters.

about.title: Most fraud tools help after the money is gone. This one helps before.
about.lede: CREDIFY.ai is an explainable scam and fraud warning assistant. You paste anything suspicious — an SMS, what a caller said, an email, a link, a payment request — and it tells you how risky it is, exactly why, and what to do next.
about.techTitle: Built to run anywhere, including offline

pwa.installText: Add to your home screen for instant access, even offline.
pwa.offlineText: No internet connection. The scanner still works — the model runs entirely on this device.
pwa.updateText: A new version of CREDIFY.ai is ready.

common.notFoundText: That page does not exist. Try the scanner or the dashboard.
